strategy.summary: The todo app (static public/app.js served by server.js) lets users tick todos complete, filter by All/Active/Completed, and clear completed todos. E2E Playwright tests must prove the strike-through and "items left" count follow the checkbox both ways, each filter shows exactly the right todos and is marked aria-pressed, and "Clear completed" is shown only while something is completed and removes all completed todos only.
inScope: Completing/uncompleting a todo via its checkbox (strike-through, items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
Visibility and behaviour of the Clear completed button
outOfScope: Adding todos beyond what setup needs (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; not in the ticket)
assumptions: The real app runs: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173; nothing is faked (there is no backend API, state lives in page memory).
Todo state is per page load, so each test creates its own todos through the UI and tests are independent.
"Struck through" is checked as the computed text-decoration-line: line-through on the todo's title, which is what the user sees (styles.css applies it to completed items).
"Shown as pressed" means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others.

risks.description: Count or strike-through not reverted on untick
Filters show wrong set, or pressed state lags the selection
risks.mitigation: TC3–TC5 assert the exact list and every button's aria-pressed

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or lingers when nothing is completed
risks.mitigation: TC6–TC7 assert exact remaining list and button visibility

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox strikes it through and decreases the items-left count by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only not-completed todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is pressed (aria-pressed=true) and the others are not.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo and no active one.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements the items left count
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox checked and title has line-through; 'Walk dog' not struck; count reads '1 item left' (was '2 items left')

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the count
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration-line is none, count back to '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk','Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed pressed, others not

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again after another filter was selected
testCases.expected: List is all three in order; All pressed, others not
testCases.rationale: Returning to All; default pressed state

testCases.title: completing a todo while Active is selected hides it from the list
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog'], count '1 item left'

testCases.title: Clear completed appears only while a todo is completed
steps: Add a todo; check button hidden
testCases.expected: Hidden with no completed todos, visible after ticking, hidden again after unticking

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer in playwright.config.js starts `node server.js` at http://localhost:4173; chromium browser must be installed.
